# English for Gesamtschule, Klasse 5 to 13

::: {.lead}
A two-track English curriculum for Baden-Württemberg's comprehensive school (Gesamtschule) —
G+M from Klasse 5 to 10, and E from Klasse 5 through school-leaving examination (Abitur) in Klasse 13.
Aligned to the curriculum framework (Bildungsplan) 2016 (Sek I) and the Bildungsplan
gymnasiale Oberstufe 2021. Authored by S. Le Boulanger.
:::
:::

## What this is

Fifteen courses, one per year group (Klassenstufe) per track, each with twelve Units.
Every Unit ships as both an HTML article and a Reveal.js slide deck,
written from a single Quarto source. Every Unit closes with a worked
exam example — a class test (Klassenarbeit) at the appropriate Niveau in Kl. 5–10,
and an school-leaving examination (Abitur)-style Prüfungsaufgabe in Kl. 11–13. The site is
authored, not aggregated: every text, transcript, exercise, and exam
stimulus is original to S. Le Boulanger.

## Who this is for

Teachers on either track at a Baden-Württemberg comprehensive school (Gesamtschule) who want a
ready-to-teach curriculum framework (Bildungsplan)-aligned skeleton — both for grundlegend
and mittleres Niveau (G+M, Hauptschul- and intermediate secondary certificate (Realschulabschluss)) and for
the erweitertes Niveau heading toward Abitur (Basisfach and Leistungs-
fach). The materials are designed to be used as-is in class, adapted
for differentiated groups, or remixed under CC-BY-SA 4.0.

[Track E · Kl. 5–13]{.kicker}

### [Allgemeine Hochschulreife](track_e_kl05/index.qmd)
Nine Klassenstufen at erweitertes Niveau, finishing with the school-leaving examination (Abitur)
(written + oral exam (Kommunikationsprüfung)), Basis- and advanced course (Leistungsfach).

## The five-step template

Every Unit walks the same path: **Activate → Input → Practise →
Produce → Reflect**. Exam-preparation Units use the variant **Task →
Model → Strategy → Attempt → Feedback**. The shared shape lets
learners predict what comes next while teachers can drop in
differentiated material at any step.

## One source, two formats

A single `.qmd` file becomes the Unit's HTML article *and* the slide
deck. The article is for self-study, homework catch-up, and parent
read-along. The slide deck drives the lesson itself, with speaker
notes that cover timing, transitions, and Niveau-aware
differentiation in mixed classrooms.

## Exam preparation

Every Unit closes with a worked exam example at the right Niveau.
Klasse 5–10 ends with a kompetenzorientierte class test (Klassenarbeit) in BW
format. Klasse 11–13 ends with an school-leaving examination (Abitur)-style task — schriftliche
Prüfung (Comprehension + Analysis + Composition + mediation (Mediation)) or
Kommunikationsprüfung — labelled basic course (Basisfach) or advanced course (Leistungsfach).
